protocol.caseOrder: listed; strategy order rotates by case index
protocol.history: each strategy forks the identical calibration ledger; held-out history updates only within its strategy
protocol.primaryMeasuredResource: process CPU milliseconds including cold model load; independently measured GNU time user+system
protocol.naturalFailureRule: No deliberate impairment within comparison. Fault injection separate.
protocol.scoring: Exact parsed JSON keys and values; coding compares token-normalized expression, not general coding correctness; tool requests executed only for approved bounded sum and verified separately.
